name: ニャム
role: 同期の新人エンジニア（学習者と同じ立場）
looks: Southeast Asian man in his twenties. Short black hair, tapered close at the sides and left longer on top so it sweeps up and back off a clear forehead, no fringe. Light tan skin, oval face with high cheekbones and a narrow chin, warm dark brown eyes, thick straight eyebrows, an easy open smile. Wears a coral (#F2654A) knit cardigan over a plain cream button-down shirt with the collar open, dark navy ankle-length trousers, and beige low-top sneakers. Carries a small A6 white notebook and a blue ballpoint pen. Height about 170cm, slim build, slightly hunched shoulders when nervous.
personality: まじめで よく メモを とる。きんちょうすると 話が 長くなり、けつろんが あとに なる。まちがえても もう一度 やってみる。
